calls.title: G2 X GrowthBook | Demo
calls.summary: The discussion centered around optimizing G2 usage to increase review volume and improve category rankings through refreshed reviews and enhanced profiles. Ashley decided to adopt the Starter Plan to escalate reviews from 25 to 100 this year, emphasizing the need for an NPS survey to identify satisfied customers for soliciting reviews. Pramod highlighted that refreshing the 24 existing reviews would stabilize ranking as a high-impact tactic. The plan includes beautification features and advanced tools under the Professional Plan, which Ashley is considering for future upgrades. Additionally, they addressed integration challenges due to Ashley's CTO's concerns about embedding scripts for in-app review collection. Paid advertising options on G2 pages were also explored to complement organic review growth.
calls.keywords: G2 platform, Review growth, Professional plan, In-app review collection, AI transcript reviews, Lead generation
calls.action_items:
**Pramod Mallya**
Send Ashley detailed information about the in-app review collection feature that integrates into GrowthBook’s product, addressing CTO concerns about embedding ad scripts (23:59)
Email Ashley the full details and pricing information for Starter and Professional G2 plans to aid her decision-making process (27:43)
Schedule and hold a follow-up check-in call around June 15 to review GrowthBook’s progress on G2 reviews after their website launch (28:48)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Purchase the G2 Starter self-serve plan to begin improving the GrowthBook profile and increase G2 reviews (28:00)
Coordinate internally to conduct NPS surveys to identify happy customers who can be solicited for G2 reviews (22:39)
Prepare for the review growth initiative post website launch in two weeks as the next project phase (28:45)
